scope: Reviewed F1 parameter and context propagation; one distinct production function per task, full original required scope.

tasks.contract: Keep request and token_handler in their declared channels when the OpenID dispatcher delegates authorization.
tasks.body:
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock
from oauthlib.openid.connect.core.grant_types.dispatchers import AuthorizationCodeGrantDispatcher
h=Mock();req=SimpleNamespace(scopes=[]);token=object()
d=AuthorizationCodeGrantDispatcher(default_grant=h)
d.create_authorization_response(req,token)
print(h.create_authorization_response.call_args)
h.create_authorization_response.assert_called_once_with(req,token)

tasks.contract: Publish the caller validator to both UserInfoEndpoint and its BearerToken consumer.
tasks.body:
from oauthlib.openid.connect.core.endpoints.userinfo import UserInfoEndpoint
v=object();e=UserInfoEndpoint(v)
print(e.request_validator,e.bearer.request_validator)
assert e.request_validator is v and e.bearer.request_validator is v

tasks.contract: Forward the same complete authorization request to the proxy validator instead of dropping client_id.
tasks.body:
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock
from oauthlib.openid.connect.core.grant_types.base import GrantTypeBase
g=GrantTypeBase.__new__(GrantTypeBase);g.proxy_target=Mock();req=SimpleNamespace(client_id='client')
g.validate_authorization_request(req)
g.proxy_target.validate_authorization_request.assert_called_once_with(req)
print('consumer_received_client_id',req.client_id)

tasks.contract: Wire validator, token callbacks and password/refresh grant handlers through the preconfigured legacy server.
tasks.body:
from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.endpoints.pre_configured import LegacyApplicationServer
v=object();gen=lambda request:'access';refresh=lambda request:'refresh'
s=LegacyApplicationServer(v,token_generator=gen,token_expires_in=77,refresh_token_generator=refresh)
assert s.refresh_grant.request_validator is v
assert s.bearer.token_generator is gen and s.bearer.expires_in==77
assert s.grant_types['password'] is s.password_grant and s.grant_types['refresh_token'] is s.refresh_grant
assert s.default_grant_type=='password'
print('legacy routing and callbacks preserved')

tasks.contract: Wire each grant handler and access/refresh token generator to the correct channel of the combined OAuth2 server.
tasks.body:
from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.endpoints.pre_configured import Server
from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.grant_types import ImplicitGrant,ResourceOwnerPasswordCredentialsGrant
v=object();gen=lambda request:'access';refresh=lambda request:'refresh'
s=Server(v,token_generator=gen,refresh_token_generator=refresh)
assert isinstance(s.implicit_grant,ImplicitGrant) and isinstance(s.password_grant,ResourceOwnerPasswordCredentialsGrant)
assert s.bearer.token_generator is gen and s.bearer.refresh_token_generator is refresh
assert s.grant_types['password'] is s.password_grant
print('combined routing preserved')

tasks.contract: Propagate validator, expiry, polling interval and verification URI to the device authorization endpoint.
tasks.body:
from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc8628.endpoints.device_authorization import DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint
v=object();e=DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint(v,verification_uri='https://example.com/verify',expires_in=77,interval=3)
assert e.request_validator is v and e.expires_in==77 and e.interval==3
assert e.verification_uri=='https://example.com/verify'
print('device options',e.expires_in,e.interval,e.verification_uri)

tasks.contract: Keep caller nonce and timestamp in their respective OAuth1 signing-context fields while preserving encoding.
tasks.body:
from oauthlib.oauth1 import Client
c=Client('key',nonce='nonce123',timestamp='1234567',encoding='utf-8')
print(c.nonce,c.timestamp)
assert c.nonce=='nonce123' and c.timestamp=='1234567'

tasks.contract: Consume include_client_id, explicit blank secret and extra token parameters according to their caller-supplied channels.
tasks.body:
from urllib.parse import parse_qs
from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.parameters import prepare_token_request
a=parse_qs(prepare_token_request('authorization_code',include_client_id=False,client_id='cid',client_secret='',code='abc'),keep_blank_values=True)
b=parse_qs(prepare_token_request('authorization_code',include_client_id=True,client_id='cid',client_secret='secret',code='abc'),keep_blank_values=True)
print(a,b)
assert 'client_id' not in a and a['client_secret']==[''] and a['code']==['abc']
assert b['client_id']==['cid'] and b['client_secret']==['secret']

tasks.contract: Filter only the OAuth parameter channel while forwarding remaining positional and keyword arguments unchanged.
tasks.body:
from oauthlib.oauth1.rfc5849.utils import filter_params
seen=[]
def target(params,*args,**kwargs):seen.append((params,args,kwargs));return 42
f=filter_params(target)
assert f([('oauth_nonce','n'),('other','x')],'extra',flag='yes')==42
print(seen)
assert seen==[([('oauth_nonce','n')],('extra',),{'flag':'yes'})]

tasks.contract: Forward the authorization code and redirect URI to nonce lookup, then carry that nonce into ID-token generation; preserve non-OpenID passthrough.
tasks.body:
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock,patch
from oauthlib.openid.connect.core.grant_types.authorization_code import AuthorizationCodeGrant
from oauthlib.openid.connect.core.grant_types.base import GrantTypeBase
g=AuthorizationCodeGrant.__new__(AuthorizationCodeGrant);g.request_validator=Mock();g.request_validator.get_authorization_code_nonce.return_value='nonce'
req=SimpleNamespace(scopes=['openid'],client_id='cid',code='code',redirect_uri='https://example.com/cb');tok={'access_token':'x'};handler=object()
with patch.object(GrantTypeBase,'add_id_token',return_value=tok) as parent:
 assert g.add_id_token(tok,handler,req) is tok
 g.request_validator.get_authorization_code_nonce.assert_called_once_with('cid','code','https://example.com/cb',req)
 parent.assert_called_once_with(tok,handler,req,nonce='nonce')
req.scopes=[]
assert g.add_id_token(tok,handler,req) is tok
print('nonce and passthrough preserved')
